_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores or through our e-commerce and mobile capabilities'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' ('We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, digital retail or through the integration of both areas), which could materially adversely affect our financial performance'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2016 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; ECOMMERCE is live (from 2015-01-01) and its competition risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Walmart

theme_watch.reason: Live: Walmart's own FY2016 10-K says 'We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, digital retail or through the integration of both areas), which could materially adversely affect our financial performance.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'E-commerce sales positively impacted comparable sales approximately 0.2% and 0.6% for Walmart U.S. and Sam's Club, respectively, for fiscal 2016'. The stock trades at 15.6x FY17E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Walmart's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores or through our e-commerce and mobile capabilities'; 'everyday low prices ("EDLP")'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' ('We face strong competition from other retailers and wholesale club operators (whether through physical retail, digital retail or through the integration of both areas), which could materially adversely affect our financial performance'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2016 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; ECOMMERCE is live (from 2015-01-01) and its competition risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Walmart. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.47x; +20% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.87; conservative 2yr +4%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -9.5%/yr (worst year FY07-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.4%/yr (FY17 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +6.4%/yr (FY07-FY16 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +11.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2017-02-03) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.47x (35.3% downside to Bear $43 / +14.3% upside to Bull $76) | Adj composite 1.88 vs market 3.75: gap -1.87 [OVERVALUED] | +20% above the EPP floor $56 (13x FY17E $4.28) | Conservative 2-yr case: +4.3% total (+2.2%/yr) | At 15.6x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $88 sits above the BULL case; U.S. comps +1.1% in Q3 FY17, forward sales +3-4% (FY17 net sales guide excluding currency and store closures); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
